treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (1996, with Protocol; modified by MLI)
eif_quote: Income Tax Conventions Implementation Act, 1997, Part 3: "[Note: Convention in force March 30, 1998, see Canada Gazette Part I, Volume 132, page 1059.]" | Treaty-accord: "Entry into Force 30 March 1998"
source_title: Income Tax Conventions Implementation Act, 1997 (S.C. 1997, c. 38), Schedule 3 - Canada-Kazakhstan Convention and Protocol (Justice Laws consolidated text)

rates.quote: (a) except in the case of dividends paid by a non-resident-owned investment corporation that is a resident of Canada, 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which controls directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the voting power in the company paying the dividends; [MLI art. 8(1): 365-day holding period, effective for WHT from 2021-01-01]
(b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2 However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if a resident of the other Contracting State is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2 However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if a resident of the other Contracting State is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: 1 Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude; having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement. [Canada notified Art. 11(8), 12(7) of the Kazakhstan Convention as existing provisions described in MLI Art. 7(2)]

notes: Art. 29(2)(a): provisions have effect for tax withheld at source on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January 1996 (retroactive; EIF 1998-03-30). Dividend 5% tier: company that "controls directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the voting power" (voting-power test recorded as ownership_threshold 10); excludes dividends paid by a Canadian non-resident-owned investment corporation. MLI art. 8 365-day holding applies to Art. 10(2)(a): Canada notified "39 Kazakhstan Article 10(2)(a)", Kazakhstan notified "7 Canada Article 10(2)(a)"; effective 2021-01-01. Protocol para. 1 MFN clause: if Kazakhstan agrees with an OECD member (member at signing) on a lower royalty rate, that lower rate applies to copyright, software and non-associated patent/know-how royalties - no official Canadian notice of an MFN-reduced rate found, so not modelled. Not modelled: Art. 11(3) exemptions (government debt interest; EDC loans of >=3 years; Kazakh Export-Import Bank credits); Art. 10(6) branch tax 5%. Existing anti-abuse clauses Art. 11(8) and 12(7) replaced by MLI PPT.
